test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**stone**'. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**stepping stone**" is commonly used to describe an action or event that helps one move towards a larger goal.
 
• Demonetisation is described as a step in the direction of a cashless India, making it a "stepping stone" towards that goal.
 
• "**Stepping stone**" (पहला कदम) fits the context of an interim measure helping to achieve the ultimate objective.
 
• Other options ("**method**", "**matter**", "**stairs**") do not capture the same figurative meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *A cashless India is the first step towards making the dream of digital India a reality. Government is trying to **create__ a cashless environment in the country. Demonetisation appears to be a stepping *__stone__ *in that direction. To help facilitate this, government even *(3)___________ *its own app ‘BHIM’ built for the same purpose. The *(4)___________ *of conducting online financial transactions is probably the biggest motivator to go digital. You will no longer need to carry wads of cash, plastic cards or even queue up for ATM withdrawals. It’s also safer and easier spending option when you are travelling. Making transactions digitally makes it easy to keep track of your finances. The *(5)___________ *are enormous for everyone if you leave out the low-income group, which will face a huge challenge. For the rest of the country, it is constructive and simple. However, the convenience of net-banking, m-banking, card or mobile wallet transactions can make you spend more than your budget.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Method **(तरीका): “Method” refers to a way of doing something, but does not capture the figurative sense of an intermediate step facilitating progression towards a larger goal.
 
• **Matter **(मामला): “Matter” refers to a subject or situation, not fitting the description of an action aiding progression.
 
• **Stairs **(सीढ़ियाँ): “Stairs” refers to a physical structure, and while related to movement, it does not have the figurative meaning of an individual step aiding progress like "stepping stone" does.
